dialogues.speaker: Iridescent Legacy: Part IV
dialogues.text: ...These are the words of the sovereign ruler Ix Roq'ratik'obala' Ka'alahun...

dialogues.speaker: Iridescent Legacy: Part IV
dialogues.text: ...Fascinating... This leader of humans is more interesting than I had expected...

dialogues.speaker: Iridescent Legacy: Part IV
dialogues.text: ...He is not Dragonborn, yet he is no less powerful than the noblest among us... On the contrary, he is more powerful by far...

dialogues.speaker: Iridescent Legacy: Part IV
dialogues.text: ...Who is advising him? Incomprehensible. If a mere mortal could truly possess the wisdom to see through my schemes, why then prostrate before another...

dialogues.speaker: Iridescent Legacy: Part IV
dialogues.text: ...Have I exhausted the limits of my body and mind? Have my senses grown dull, blunted by the degradations imposed by rank and power... To have forgotten that humans, too...

dialogues.speaker: Iridescent Legacy: Part IV
dialogues.text: ...My king... we — your kin — are enfeebled, decayed... Why has it taken me so long to see...
